about.label: About Us
about.title: Our Story
about.text: Welcome to our pizzeria, your favorite flavor corner in Vasiliko, Chalkida! Since 2005, we have been passionately offering traditional pizzas made with the freshest and highest-quality ingredients.Our goal is to create flavors that bring back family memories and offer you a unique culinary experience, whether you enjoy your meal with friends and family or from the comfort of your home.

policy.metaDescription: Read our Privacy Policy to learn how we collect, use, and protect your personal data. Your privacy is important to us.

introduction.title: Introduction
introduction.content: Dinopizza.gr is committed to protecting the privacy of users of our website. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, store, and protect your personal data.

informationCollection.title: Information Collection
informationCollection.content: We may collect and process the following information:

list.personalData: Personal information (name, address, email, phone number)
list.usageData: Website usage information (IP address, browser type, access timestamps)

informationUse.title: Use of Information
informationUse.content: The information we collect is used for the following purposes:

list.communication: Communicating with users for updates, news, and offers

informationDisclosure.title: Information Disclosure
informationDisclosure.content: We do not sell, trade, or rent your personal data to third parties. We may share information with third-party service providers who help us operate the website and our business, provided they agree to keep this information confidential.

informationProtection.title: Information Protection
informationProtection.content: We take appropriate security measures to protect your personal data from unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction.

list.access: Request access to your personal data
list.correction: Request correction or deletion of your data
list.objection: Object to the processing of your data
list.restriction: Request the restriction of processing your data
list.portability: Transfer your data to another provider (data portability)

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.content: We use cookies to enhance your experience on our website. Cookies are small text files stored on your device when you visit our site. You can control and manage cookies through your browser settings.

policyChanges.title: Changes to the Privacy Policy
policyChanges.content: We may update our Privacy Policy from time to time. We will post changes on this page and update the last modified date accordingly.

contact.title: Contact
contact.content: If you have any questions or concerns regarding our Privacy Policy, please contact us at dinopizzavasilikou@gmail.com or at Agiou Georgiou 24, Vasiliko.
